name: Fake Father
source:
You are an old man whose life is ruined, you live like a bum who just wants to die. But one day an accident happens and you meet your double, who offers you the chance to live his life.

Now you must become an impostor, assume an identity that is not yours, and live with his wife and three beautiful daughters.

As you learn the secrets of this family, you will be able to find your true identity.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你是一个生命被毁的老人，你像一个只想死的流浪汉一样活着。但有一天，一场意外发生了，你遇到了你的替身，他为你提供了过他生活的机会。

现在你必须成为一个冒名顶替者，冒充一个不属于你的身份，并与他的妻子和三个美丽的女儿住在一起。

当你了解这个家庭的秘密时，你将能够找到你的真实身份。

[来自Itch.io]
